English.Text: Treasures unearthed from the desert sands draw scholars from far and wide and inspire new research.

Standard.Name: Raised among oases and ancient orchards, Fatima learned from a young age to read the rhythm of trees as others read the stars. Her knowledge combines precise pruning, patient watering, and the correct use of selected shoots—practices passed down from generation to generation.

Standard.Name: Mariam grew up among orchards where pomegranate trees were treated with almost ritualistic care. She knows the pruning, irrigation, and flowering cycles that allow for more abundant and consistent fruit production. Her presence in the fields improves yield without exhausting the trees.

Standard.Name: This method organizes the manual pollination of date palms, a traditional practice in orchards. By coordinating schedules and skilled hands, a higher fruiting rate is ensured. The system reduces losses caused by irregular or late pollination, although it requires planning and additional work during the peak season.

Standard.Name: Hassan has spent his life following the desert routes, raising camels resistant to the heat and the long journey. He knows the value of each animal by its gait, its breath, and the strength of its legs, and he carefully selects the specimens destined for breeding.

Standard.Name: This system organizes the pruning, watering, and harvesting of roses according to well-defined seasonal cycles. By synchronizing the gardeners' work, more abundant and uniform blooms are achieved. This practice reduces losses due to disease and soil depletion. It requires discipline and planning, but rewards with more consistent harvests.

Standard.Name: Yusuf is known for his skill in pressing pomegranates, a delicate fruit whose juice requires patience and well-measured strength. For years he has perfected methods that prevent pulp loss and preserve the deep color of the extracted liquid.

Standard.Name: Salim gained fame for his ability to maintain the flow of juice even when pomegranates were scarce or arrived damaged at the workshop. Quickly, and with questionable judgment, he substituted the fruit with citrus fruits of similar acidity, achieving a liquid that looked convincing at first glance.

Standard.Name: Originally from Tabriz, Farhad learned the art of textile production from childhood, counting knots before he could read. Standard.Name: Responsible for organizing mining crews and assigning tasks to keep every gallery in full operation. His experience enables him to minimize downtime and make the most of each excavation shift. Under his supervision, the flow of tools, workers, and extracted ore remains steady.

Standard.Name: Nasrin knows the clay-rich lands of the region. She organizes the extraction process based on the moisture and consistency of the ground. Her expertise makes it possible to utilize even those deposits that are most difficult to work with.

Standard.Name: The accumulation of water poses a threat to mine galleries and necessitates the suspension of excavation work at many sites. Dewatering pumps make it possible to drain shafts and keep work areas accessible. Their use facilitates deeper excavation and the recovery of ground that would otherwise remain flooded.
